  A search in Patricia's tree is carried out as follows: Suppose we are looking up
  the word THE (bit pattern 10111 01000 00101). We start by looking at the SKIP
    eld of the root node , which tells us to examine the rst bit of the argument.
  It is 1, so we move to the right. The SKIP eld in the next node, , tells us to
  look at the 1 + 11 = 12th bit of the argument. It is 0, so we move to the left.
  The SKIP eld of the next node, , tells us to look at the (12 + 1)st bit, which
  is 1; now we nd RTAG = 1, so we go back to node , which refers us to the TEXT.
  The search path we have taken would occur for any argument whose bit pattern
  is 1xxxx xxxxx x01: : : , and we must check to see if it matches the unique key
  beginning with that pattern.
